# Implementation-closeout checklist

Authority: Theme 15 accepted. Used by skill `implementation-closeout`.  
**Readiness only** — no commit/push/PR/merge steps here.

## Classifier

```text
Mode: define-update | check
Profile path (or create): 
Trivial skip?: yes | no — reason:
```

## Define / update

```text
- [ ] Load or create host profile from docs/templates/closeout-profile.md
- [ ] Confirm criteria match host requirements (add/remove rows)
- [ ] Leave ceremony as optional note only (no gh spine)
```

## Check

```text
- [ ] Load profile
- [ ] Score each required criterion: ready | blocked | waived | n/a + evidence locator
- [ ] No invented greens (cite-or-omit / draft≠SoT)
- [ ] Overall verdict + gaps list
- [ ] Hand human for ceremony if ready (or blocked reasons if not)
```
